Share Appeal Sunday 2026 “In November each year we take the opportunity, on Share Appeal Sunday, to remind ourselves about the second collection taken up at weekend Masses throughout the year.
Share, the diocesan development fund, depends on the generosity of parishioners.
It reflects, practically, our mission, service and solidarity, responding to needs felt in parishes across the Archdiocese.
Because of your generosity to Share, a wide range of skilled personnel are available to parishes from the diocesan offices.
They offer consultation, training, formation and guidance concerning local pastoral, education, strategic leadership, safeguarding and communications initiatives.
Thank you in anticipation for giving what you can on this Share Appeal Sunday, and for your continued support for Share at the second collection every Sunday throughout the year.
May we be a people blessed with wisdom, humility, generosity, and great hope.” +Dermot Farrell, Archbishop of Dublin The Share Newsletter can be found at:
